spec.description: Setup for case L10 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/worktrees (L10-calcite-fix = 5f48eec8d5e3f25df641393c9440e086646868b7, L10-calcite-parent = b8ccec91b7670d8c62a5712e210bb25f396ade7e), runs the upstream Gradle build (Gradle 8.14.4, sha256 checked against services.gradle.org and the wrapper's distributionSha256Sum; Gradle on JDK 21.0.13, compile toolchain JDK 25.0.5 as the build asks; --no-scan; dependencies already resolved inline): :core:jar and :core:test for CoreQuidemTest (all Quidem files, planner.iq among them) and RelOptRulesTest, on the fix (first build may go online) then offline, on the parent offline, then the fix's planner.iq and RelOptRulesTest.xml transplanted onto the parent (planner.iq's CALCITE-7909 block and testMinusMergeRule are expected to fail). Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief-setup.md.
